dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts the Schedule “4” road ROW width hierarchy which represent important mobility corridors for active transportation, transit, and automobiles.

Right-of-Way Widths identify the planned minimum width of land required for streets within Brampton’s transportation network. These widths provide space for roadways, sidewalks, cycling facilities, transit infrastructure, utilities, landscaping, and other public realm elements needed to support safe and efficient movement of people and goods.
Regional Roads are major transportation corridors under the jurisdiction of the Region of Peel that provide important connections between municipalities, centres, employment areas, and provincial highways. Planned right-of-way widths along these roads ensure sufficient space for future road improvements, transit services, active transportation facilities, utilities, and streetscape enhancements.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
dct_title_s: Brampton Plan Schedule 4 - City Road ROW Widths
